goal: Deliver one coherent, source-truth-driven repair candidate for both saved correction lists and explain every remaining API change or gap by correction ID.

intent_model.literal_request: Execute the two saved lists, check live API data before treating old-site differences as defects, fix everything locally and explain API work by item.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A stable final solution in which public behavior, supplier truth, normalization, filters, media identity and release evidence agree across all VII worlds.
likely_rejections: One or more saved item IDs are omitted.
A legacy difference is copied without live source verification.
A local UI workaround masks an upstream or normalization defect.
Shared-family regressions appear in another world, locale or viewport.
Production is changed without explicit authorization.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Close the causal chain from supplier/API through normalization, filtering, caching and rendering, not only the reported screenshot.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Every item needs source, cause, fix and family regression evidence, or a precise external blocker.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Use read-only live source queries before relying on legacy output for availability, price, capacity, units, amenities or media.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Data items must include redacted API evidence and cause classification.

cognitive_flow.current_decision: For each discrepancy, identify whether ownership is upstream API, provider adapter, canonical normalization, filter/ranking, cache or UI.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Implement and verify the smallest causal fix across the complete affected family.
deferred_complexity: External supplier contract changes requiring their action
Outbound emails or production data mutations
preserved_depth: Desktop, mobile, low-height and locale regression evidence

natural_destination: The local production-mode VII release candidate on the exact public route families.

facts.claim: The exact public source baseline is c8cbda44a8f1565d6cbac4b9f07bd249f326e741.
facts.evidence: Git log and prior v917 deployment evidence.

facts.claim: The saved scope contains KIRA-01..12 and LIRAN-01..29.

assumptions.claim: The configured live API endpoints can be queried read-only from the development environment.
assumptions.validation: Inspect existing project configuration and run bounded redacted probes without exposing secrets.

in_scope: All KIRA-01..12 and LIRAN-01..29 correction families
Local API, adapter, canonical, filtering, caching, UI and test changes
Source-to-UI cause ledger and item mapping
out_of_scope: Production deployment without a new explicit instruction
Production database mutations, supplier writes or outbound business messaging
invariants: Old-site output is not copied when it conflicts with verified live source truth.
Unit and general place media identities remain separate.
Full result and gallery routes do not inherit slider caps.
Existing approved layout, typography, navigation and conversion behavior remain unchanged outside affected families.
affected_family: Search, results, filters, maps and booking CTAs
Availability, price, capacity and minimum-stay data
Place, unit, spa-package and event detail data
Galleries, video, amenities, sharing and reviews
Loaders, caching, errors, back navigation and responsive transitions
Localization, robots, sitemap, canonicals, redirects and release identity

requirements.statement: Classify and repair every KIRA-01..12 item within authorization, with explicit blockers for domain, owner or publication-only actions.
Classify and repair every LIRAN-01..29 item within authorization across the complete shared family.
For every old/new mismatch involving data, inspect live API truth first and classify the cause as upstream API, adapter/normalization, filter/ranking, cache, rendering or legacy-only.
Return a clear API change/gap ledger mapped to the exact Kira and Liran item IDs.
Preserve verified existing behavior and pass automated plus natural-surface checks for changed families on desktop, mobile, low height and relevant locales/states.
requirements.source: VII feedback standard and accepted account lessons

requirements.statement: URL, filter, selection, retry, back-navigation and administration state affected by the changes survives the relevant reload or navigation boundary.

acceptance_checks.setup: The two saved lists and exact public baseline are loaded.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: All 41 item IDs have owner, cause, implementation status, evidence and any exact external blocker; none are omitted or generically marked done.

acceptance_checks.setup: A representative discrepancy exists between old and new behavior.
acceptance_checks.action: Probe the live API read-only and trace the same entity through normalization and filters.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The final cause is demonstrated and the fix occurs in the owning layer; unavailable upstream fields are not invented.

acceptance_checks.setup: The supplier returns no confirmable availability, price or media for the requested identity.
acceptance_checks.action: Open the corresponding result or detail flow.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The page shows the truthful localized enquiry or unavailable state without contradictory CTA, borrowed media, fake price or false online-booking claim.

acceptance_checks.setup: A supplier request is slow, times out or fails.
acceptance_checks.action: Exercise loading, failure and retry on affected search and slider flows.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The interface remains atomic and responsive, exposes one actionable localized state, prevents duplicate work and recovers without stale or contradictory content.

acceptance_checks.setup: The live supplier or API cannot provide a required field, identity or timely response.
acceptance_checks.action: Trace the failed field through the adapter and render the affected public flow.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The owning upstream gap is recorded against exact correction IDs, the product degrades honestly without invented data, and unrelated results remain usable.

acceptance_checks.setup: A visitor has selected world, location, dates, guests, filters, unit or sort state.
acceptance_checks.action: Navigate, reload, use back, and cross relevant responsive boundaries.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The URL, visible controls, count, list, map and selected unit remain one consistent state without reset or overflow.

acceptance_checks.setup: The release candidate fails a critical family gate.
acceptance_checks.action: Reject the candidate and retain the exact public baseline commit.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No production change occurs and c8cbda44 remains the documented rollback baseline.

open_questions.question: Which upstream fields or supplier endpoints are actually absent or inconsistent?
open_questions.resolution: Resolve per item through bounded read-only live API probes and record the result in the reconciliation ledger.

authorization_boundary: Implement and test locally, including read-only live API verification. Do not deploy, cut over domains, publish indexation policy, mutate production data or send external messages without explicit authorization.
